# High Roller Technologies to Present at the 2026 ThinkEquity Conference


October 09, 2026 9:00 am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_972a13f6e2433668d2cd18ebebd4cd30/highroller/news/2026-10-09_High_Roller_Technologies_to_Present_at_the_2026_168.pdf)


*Management will be available for one-on-one investor meetings on October 15 in New York City*


LAS VEGAS, Nevada, Oct. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- High Roller Technologies, Inc. (“High Roller” or the “Company”) (NYSE: ROLR), an online gaming and prediction markets company, today announced that management will present at the 2026 ThinkEquity Conference on Thursday, October 15, 2026, at the Mandarin Oriental Hotel in New York City.


The presentation will provide an overview of High Roller’s business, strategy and recent developments, including its ROLR™ prediction markets platform. Management will also be available for one-on-one meetings with investors throughout the conference.


**Conference Details**


**Event:** 2026 ThinkEquity Conference
**Date:** Thursday, October 15, 2026
**Location:** Mandarin Oriental Hotel, 80 Columbus Circle, New York City
**Presentation Time:** 11:30 a.m. Eastern Time
**Conference Information:**[ThinkEquity conference website](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dosipRQL0u6_00k2D2lvZcPmj_LUbpJyd0i8hwEL0PnyBWRddlO2xnsZK7r9QKnBFMWcSQ5hXWOk_870fbl_APbN91UPakDGBuPtr0N1sUZkdB3QC1e4M0dtyL0jSmcsvP00xGGbnyr0G_KDepjWRw==)


Investors interested in scheduling a one-on-one meeting with High Roller may contact their ThinkEquity representative.


**About High Roller Technologies, Inc.**


High Roller Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: ROLR) is a publicly traded online gaming and prediction markets company, known for its innovative casino brands[High Roller](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kMpWfJDetKvZgDFBjjfwU8zMWpuNwZBzXm84W9knw8b1chTBdUdYupCNR4iH5vEw1QsCF203qtkvZkfrBFn-IqPzAIQH8tbyv3l1zVS5P1SVLiGrpyeextmZBe6Zu6eEsYI-nuKbmKh5NRt5XUPBPBCFk0jsLrVzGB8AXleHE2SLssyfvz35RXYeh50DHK8oCAKQ72ZGWggp56T5AAAlhOQLwOFY-iYBnbngROS9eE4=) and[Fruta](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=U7DyOb9djw3nc5nu3dm40JmXzzOXjE-jBIVGRyP-JVbwhE65LRY5abVbzyIulKmce32dktnik8-7d2YMwannbwSq4bYZgZ2fSBEn-R09N2jHk7RMIiQORuH_UZfsGhXjynZ6UY5N9O00toECYkuU44Wr8SYK0_JD-kTXbDWt1q7Zx8gPNn659GjAMlImsakD9w4BCsSPFWo-VArLbwnKo3iZ5QbUCGoWfUSNPJwpASY=) , and its prediction markets brand,[ROLR](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Gyz_SvvwUCYvzpkGrKyv67Mj5Me59_BQbV7Vt5S00Y8WTOz7qXT_hraFkSF_L1CZiLgqqeVTpmeo-n9bW381Qw_uEt1aTtppeXS82Kdz4Tnko-UumirDpNmjTjPCTSqMBTFQcMIMS_unIjV7N1chvf5h1PlxyOLrmAclc1oNWS1xPTl64ODLu3G-SeBR8JDLzMi2cw5nBLMBQd5-rx2hF6d5et0aODBcb9NBUKPJgNs=) . The Company delivers cutting-edge real-money consumer facing products that are intuitive and user-friendly. With a diverse portfolio of over 6,000 premium online casino games from more than 90 leading game providers, High Roller Technologies offers an immersive and engaging gaming experience in the rapidly expanding multi-billion-dollar iGaming industry. As an award-winning operator, High Roller Technologies continues to redefine the future of market engagement through innovation, performance, and a commitment to excellence.
